items.title: Berkshire Hathaway (BRK.A) Puts $6.8 Billion Behind Greg Abel’s Housing Bet
items.summary: Berkshire Hathaway (NYSE:BRK.A) completes a US$6.8b acquisition of Taylor Morrison, signaling a housing focused move under new CEO Greg Abel. The company expands positions in several large US homebuilders alongside the Taylor Morrison deal. The activity points to a long term commitment to the US housing market and domestic economic fundamentals. items.title: Warren Buffett Turns 96 on Sunday. His Final Berkshire Masterpiece Isn’t Winning Over Wall Street.
items.summary: Warren Buffett is getting high marks for his role as  Berkshire Hathaway’s  chairman as he approaches his 96th birthday on Sunday.  Since he stepped down as CEO at the start of the year, Buffett has remained very much in the game, including involvement in Berkshire’s share buybacks and its large  Alphabet  stake.
